1.explanation: This minimal React app pulls in both the new IconButton component and the legacy Button (with hasIconOnly) and places them side by side on a colored background. You’ll immediately see that IconButton applies too much right padding (matching medium button paddings) whereas the hasIconOnly Button is balanced. Importing the SCSS/CSS from @carbon/react ensures you’re exercising the exact styles shipped in version 1.1.0.
1.bug_scenario: When you render a standalone IconButton from @carbon/react it ends up with too much space on its right side. In the screenshot (blue background), the pencil icon is centered correctly on the left but the button’s right padding is far larger than the left, making the icon feel misaligned.
